title: MOF IntelliServe – AI-Powered Conversational & Document Intelligence for Financial Services
summary: The UAE Ministry of Finance reports that its live assistant provides instant bilingual answers and document search, reducing routine manual effort. Cost savings remain expected.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The UAE Ministry of Finance reports that its assistant is in full production and provides instant bilingual answers and document search, reducing routine manual effort. Cost savings remain expected.
purpose: Help users find financial-service information and reduce routine inquiry handling.

ratings.reason: The live service is described as providing immediate bilingual answers and document retrieval, a convenience and search-time benefit. Learning or financial outcomes are not established.
The Ministry reports automation of routine inquiries and document handling, reducing manual effort. Monetary savings remain expected and unquantified.

ai_role.statement: The project account does not separately evaluate AI’s contribution to the benefit.

evidence.citation: Project account in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. Outcomes are reported by the project team. The account provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 1: MOF IntelliServe – AI-Powered Conversational & Document Intelligence for Financial Services

produced_by: Conditions that could produce the benefit are unspecified.
must_hold: Arabic/English financial documents and service information
Document processing, retrieval infrastructure, and routing to human staff

headline: MOF IntelliServe answers queries and reads documents
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
